content.comment_body: Hello! I'm experiencing an issue with a PLC program on my computer. Although I haven't set a password in either the PLC or the program on my computer, I'm now prompted for a password when I try to open it. Previously, I was able to use and edit a similar program without any issues, but now it unexpectedly asks for a password. What could be causing this password requirement to appear? Did I accidentally enable or disable a parameter? Any ideas? This is quite puzzling. // [user_name]
Unfortunately, I'm not sure which password you're referring to. Could you provide a screenshot of the password prompt? Alternatively, you can send the program to me via private message.

Hello [user_name], Was the program originally created using an older version of [product_name]? And was a password never set? If so, there is a known issue with [product_name] [version_no]. In some cases, restarting your PC might resolve it. Otherwise, you could try using [product_name] from an older [version_no]. This topic has come up frequently in the forum (example: [url]). If you no longer have access to the older version, consider uploading your program. Someone may be able to convert it for you to work with [product_name] [version_no]. Best regards, [user_name] (translated via Google)

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering unexpected password prompts when accessing PLC programs, even when no password was set. This issue appears related to compatibility problems or bugs introduced in recent [product_name] software versions, especially [version_no]. The sudden requirement for a password is causing confusion, and users are unsure which settings may be responsible for triggering these prompts.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to access and edit PLC programs freely unless they themselves have specifically set a password. There is a strong desire for clear information about when and why password protection becomes mandatory.
